```{python}
# | echo: false
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import sqlalchemy as sql
import plotly.express as px
import plotly.io as pio
import yaml

pio.renderers.default = "notebook"
from IPython.display import display, HTML, Markdown


def build_scatter_plot(df, y_var, title, x_range=None, y_range=None) -> None:
    """Build Control Scatter plot for a given control."""
    plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
    scatter = plt.scatter(df["Control"], df[y_var], s=75)
    plt.title(title)
    plt.xlabel("Control")
    plt.ylabel(y_var)

    # Add horizontal line at y=0
    plt.axhline(0, color="black", linewidth=1, linestyle="dashed")

    # Update x-axis and y-axis with provided ranges
    if x_range is not None:
        plt.xlim(x_range)
    if y_range is not None:
        plt.ylim(y_range)

    plt.show()


def summarize_controls(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Compute summary statistics for Controls."""
    result = pd.DataFrame()
    for field in ["Control Field", "Category"]:
        summary = (
            df.groupby(field)
            .agg(
                Avg_Diff=("Diff", "mean"),
                Med_Diff=("Diff", "median"),
                Avg_Diff_Pct=("Diff %", "mean"),
                Med_Diff_Pct=("Diff %", "median"),
                Max_Diff=("Diff", lambda x: x.abs().max()),
                Max_Diff_Pct=("Diff %", lambda x: x.abs().max()),
            )
            .round(2)
            .reset_index()
            .rename(
                columns={
                    field: "Control Field",
                    "Avg_Diff": "Avg Diff",
                    "Med_Diff": "Med Diff",
                    "Avg_Diff_Pct": "Avg Diff %",
                    "Med_Diff_Pct": "Med Diff %",
                    "Max_Diff": "Max |Diff|",
                    "Max_Diff_Pct": "Max |Diff %|",
                }
            )
        )

        result = pd.concat([result, summary])

    return result
```

```{python}
# | tags: [parameters]
# | echo: false
run_id = 63  # placeholder run_id parameter
```

```{python}
# | echo: false
# Load configuration
with open("../secrets.yml", "r") as file:
    secrets = yaml.safe_load(file)

# Build SQL engine from configuration
engine = sql.create_engine(
    "mssql+pyodbc://@"
    + secrets["sql"]["server"]
    + "/"
    + secrets["sql"]["output_database"]
    + "?trusted_connection=yes&driver=ODBC Driver 17 for SQL Server",
    fast_executemany=True,
)

# Load run metadata and controls/results from SQL
with engine.connect() as connection:
    with open("../report/metadata.sql", "r") as query:
        run_df = pd.read_sql_query(
            sql.text(query.read().format(run_id=run_id)),
            connection,
        )

    with open("../report/controls.sql", "r") as query:
        controls_df = pd.read_sql_query(
            sql.text(query.read().format(run_id=run_id)),
            connection,
        )
```


## [run_id] = `{python} run_id`

SANDAG sets control parameters at both the Region, PUMA, and MGRA geography levels. Below, you will find interactive tabs comparing outputs to control totals at all levels of geography.

::: {.panel-tabset}
### Region

```{python}
# | echo: false
fig = px.scatter(
    controls_df[controls_df["geography"] == "region"],
    x="Control",
    y="Diff",
    hover_data=["Control Field"],
    title="Control Matching - Numeric Difference",
)
fig.update_traces(marker=dict(size=12))
fig.add_hline(y=0, line_dash="dash", line_color="black")
fig.show()
```
```{python}
# | echo: false
fig = px.scatter(
    controls_df[controls_df["geography"] == "region"],
    x="Control",
    y="Diff %",
    hover_data=["Control Field"],
    title="Control Matching - Percent Difference",
)
fig.update_traces(marker=dict(size=12))
fig.add_hline(y=0, line_dash="dash", line_color="black")
fig.show()
```

            formatters={

### PUMA

::: {.panel-tabset}

```{python}
# | output: asis
# | echo: false
puma_df = controls_df[controls_df["geography"] == "PUMA"]
# For each Category of PUMA controls
for x in puma_df["Category"].unique():

    # Add a title/tabset
    display(Markdown(f"### {x}"))
    tbl = puma_df[puma_df["Category"] == x][
        [
            "Category",
            "Control Field",
            "Control",
            "Result",
            "Diff",
            "Diff %",
        ]
    ]

    # Build numeric difference plot
    build_scatter_plot(
        df=tbl,
        y_var="Diff",
        title=f"{x} - Numeric Difference",
        x_range=(0, puma_df["Control"].max()),
        y_range=(puma_df["Diff"].min(), puma_df["Diff"].max()),
    )

    # Build percentage difference plot
    build_scatter_plot(
        df=tbl,
        y_var="Diff %",
        title=f"{x} - Percent Difference",
        x_range=(0, puma_df["Control"].max()),
        y_range=(puma_df["Diff %"].min(), puma_df["Diff %"].max()),
    )

    # Show table of summary statistics
    display(
        HTML(
            summarize_controls(tbl).to_html(
                index=False,
                formatters={
                    "Avg Diff": lambda x: "{:,}".format(x),
                    "Med Diff": lambda x: "{:,}".format(x),
                    "Avg Diff %": lambda x: "{:,}".format(x),
                    "Med Diff %": lambda x: "{:,}".format(x),
                    "Max |Diff|": lambda x: "{:,}".format(x),
                    "Max |Diff %|": lambda x: "{:,}".format(x),
                },
            )
        )
    )

    print("")
```
